en.g: Invite people in a friendly, polite way.
p: Would you like to come to my party? is polite and warm.
Do you want to join us? is more casual, perfect for friends.
Add the details: It's on Friday at seven, at my place.
en.q: Invite me to something fun this weekend. What do you say?
en.c: Write three invitations in English: one polite, one casual, one with full details.

de.g: Du lädst Menschen freundlich und höflich ein.
p: Would you like to come to my party? ist höflich und herzlich.
Do you want to join us? ist lockerer, ideal unter Freunden.
Füg die Details hinzu: It's on Friday at seven, at my place.
de.q: Lad mich zu etwas Schönem am Wochenende ein. Was sagst du?
de.c: Schreib drei Einladungen auf Englisch: eine höfliche, eine lockere, eine mit allen Details.

es.g: Invita a la gente de forma amable y educada.
p: Would you like to come to my party? es educado y cálido.
Do you want to join us? es más informal, ideal entre amigos.
Añade los detalles: It's on Friday at seven, at my place.
es.q: Invítame a algo divertido este fin de semana. ¿Qué me dices?
es.c: Escribe tres invitaciones en inglés: una educada, una informal y una con todos los detalles.

fr.g: Inviter quelqu'un de façon chaleureuse et polie.

fr.q: Invite-moi à quelque chose de sympa ce week-end. Que dis-tu ?
fr.c: Écris trois invitations en anglais : une polie, une familière, une avec tous les détails.

it.c: Scrivi tre inviti in inglese: uno educato, uno informale e uno con tutti i dettagli.

en.g: Answer invitations kindly, whether you say yes or no.
p: To accept: Yes, I'd love to! or That sounds great, thanks!
To decline: Sorry, I can't, I'm busy. Always give a short reason.
Keep it friendly: Maybe next time? or Thanks for asking!
en.q: I invite you to a picnic on Sunday. Can you come? Answer politely.
en.c: Write one yes reply and one no reply to the same invitation.

de.g: Du antwortest freundlich auf Einladungen, ob mit Ja oder Nein.
p: Zusagen: Yes, I'd love to! oder That sounds great, thanks!
Absagen: Sorry, I can't, I'm busy. Nenn immer kurz einen Grund.
Bleib freundlich: Maybe next time? oder Thanks for asking!
de.q: Ich lade dich am Sonntag zum Picknick ein. Kommst du? Antworte höflich.
de.c: Schreib eine Zusage und eine Absage auf dieselbe Einladung.

es.g: Responde con amabilidad a las invitaciones, digas sí o no.
p: Para aceptar: Yes, I'd love to! o That sounds great, thanks!
Para rechazar: Sorry, I can't, I'm busy. Da siempre una razón breve.
Mantén el tono amable: Maybe next time? o Thanks for asking!
es.q: Te invito a un picnic el domingo. ¿Puedes venir? Contesta con educación.
es.c: Escribe una respuesta de sí y otra de no a la misma invitación.

fr.g: Répondre gentiment à une invitation, que ce soit oui ou non.
p: Pour accepter : Yes, I'd love to! ou That sounds great, thanks!
Pour refuser : Sorry, I can't, I'm busy. Donne toujours une courte raison.
Reste aimable : Maybe next time? ou Thanks for asking!
fr.q: Je t'invite à un pique-nique dimanche. Tu peux venir ? Réponds poliment.
fr.c: Écris une réponse positive et une négative à la même invitation.

it.g: Rispondi con gentilezza agli inviti, che sia sì o no.
p: Per accettare: Yes, I'd love to! oppure That sounds great, thanks!

Resta cordiale: Maybe next time? oppure Thanks for asking!
it.q: Ti invito a un picnic domenica. Puoi venire? Rispondi con garbo.
it.c: Scrivi una risposta di sì e una di no allo stesso invito.

pt.g: Responde com simpatia aos convites, seja sim ou não.

pt.c: Escreve uma resposta de sim e outra de não ao mesmo convite.

en.g: Talk about your plans with be going to plus a verb.
p: Form: am, is or are plus going to plus base verb: I'm going to visit my aunt.
Negative: I'm not going to work on Sunday. Question: Are you going to come?
Use it for decisions you already made before speaking.
en.q: What are you going to do this weekend? Tell me two plans.
en.c: Write five plans for next week with going to, one for each day.

de.q: Was hast du am Wochenende vor? Nenn mir zwei Pläne.
de.c: Schreib fünf Pläne für nächste Woche mit going to, einen pro Tag.

en.t: Future time words: tomorrow, next week
en.g: Place your plans in the future with clear time words.
p: Tomorrow, tonight and this weekend talk about the near future.
Next comes before the period with no the: next week, next month, next year.
In plus a time tells you how long until it happens: in two days, in an hour.
en.q: What are you going to do tomorrow evening and next weekend?
en.c: Make a mini plan with six future time words and one going to sentence each.

In plus Zeit sagt, wann etwas passiert: in two days, in an hour.
de.q: Was machst du morgen Abend und am nächsten Wochenende?
de.c: Mach einen Mini-Plan mit sechs Zukunftswörtern und je einem going-to-Satz.

en.g: Compare two things with -er, more, better and worse.
p: Short adjectives add -er: cheap becomes cheaper, big becomes bigger.
Long adjectives use more: more interesting, more expensive. Add than: bigger than.
Irregular ones: good becomes better, bad becomes worse.
en.q: Which is better for you, the city or the countryside? Say why with a comparative.
en.c: Compare two places you know in five sentences with -er, more and than.

de.g: Du vergleichst zwei Dinge mit -er, more, better und worse.
p: Kurze Adjektive bekommen -er: cheap wird cheaper, big wird bigger.
Lange Adjektive nehmen more: more interesting, more expensive. Dazu than: bigger than.
Unregelmäßig: good wird better, bad wird worse.
de.q: Was ist besser für dich, Stadt oder Land? Begründe es mit einem Komparativ.
de.c: Vergleiche zwei Orte, die du kennst, in fünf Sätzen mit -er, more und than.

es.g: Compara dos cosas con -er, more, better y worse.
p: Los adjetivos cortos añaden -er: cheap pasa a cheaper, big a bigger.
Los largos usan more: more interesting, more expensive. Y luego than: bigger than.
Irregulares: good pasa a better, bad a worse.
es.q: ¿Qué es mejor para ti, la ciudad o el campo? Explícalo con un comparativo.
es.c: Compara dos lugares que conozcas en cinco frases con -er, more y than.

fr.g: Comparer deux choses avec -er, more, better et worse.
p: Les adjectifs courts prennent -er : cheap devient cheaper, big devient bigger.
Les longs prennent more : more interesting, more expensive. Puis than : bigger than.
Irréguliers : good devient better, bad devient worse.
fr.q: Qu'est-ce qui est mieux pour toi, la ville ou la campagne ? Explique avec un comparatif.
fr.c: Compare deux lieux que tu connais en cinq phrases avec -er, more et than.

it.g: Confronti due cose con -er, more, better e worse.
p: Gli aggettivi brevi aggiungono -er: cheap diventa cheaper, big diventa bigger.
Quelli lunghi usano more: more interesting, more expensive. Poi than: bigger than.
Irregolari: good diventa better, bad diventa worse.
it.q: Per te è meglio la città o la campagna? Spiega perché con un comparativo.
it.c: Confronta due posti che conosci in cinque frasi con -er, more e than.

pt.g: Compara duas coisas com -er, more, better e worse.

Irregulares: good fica better, bad fica worse.
pt.q: O que é melhor para ti, a cidade ou o campo? Explica com um comparativo.
pt.c: Compara dois sítios que conheces em cinco frases com -er, more e than.

Irregulares: good vira better, bad vira worse.
pt_BR.q: O que é melhor para você, a cidade ou o interior? Explique com um comparativo.
pt_BR.c: Compare dois lugares que você conhece em cinco frases com -er, more e than.

target.gram: Comparatives: short adj + -er + than (bigger than), long adj: more + adj + than. Irregular: good-better, bad-worse.

en.g: Say which thing is number one with superlatives.
p: Short adjectives: the plus -est: the tallest, the biggest, the cheapest.
Long adjectives: the most plus adjective: the most beautiful, the most famous.
Irregular: good becomes the best, bad becomes the worst.
en.q: What is the most beautiful place you know? And the best food you ever ate?

en.g: Describe your city, town or village with useful adjectives.
p: Busy and crowded mean full of people. Quiet and peaceful mean calm.
Modern, old and historic describe buildings. Beautiful and ugly give your opinion.
Use very, quite or really to make them stronger: It's really busy at night.
en.q: How would you describe the place where you live in three adjectives?
en.c: Write a short description of your street or neighbourhood with five adjectives.

de.g: Du beschreibst deine Stadt oder dein Dorf mit nützlichen Adjektiven.
p: Busy und crowded heißen voller Menschen. Quiet und peaceful heißen ruhig.
Modern, old und historic beschreiben Gebäude. Beautiful und ugly geben deine Meinung.
Mit very, quite oder really verstärkst du sie: It's really busy at night.
de.q: Wie beschreibst du deinen Wohnort mit drei Adjektiven?
de.c: Schreib eine kurze Beschreibung deiner Straße oder deines Viertels mit fünf Adjektiven.

Refuérzalos con very, quite o really: It's really busy at night.
es.q: ¿Cómo describirías el lugar donde vives con tres adjetivos?

fr.g: Décrire ta ville ou ton village avec des adjectifs utiles.

Rinforzali con very, quite o really: It's really busy at night.
it.q: Come descriveresti il posto dove vivi con tre aggettivi?
it.c: Scrivi una breve descrizione della tua via o del tuo quartiere con cinque aggettivi.

pt.g: Descreve a tua cidade ou aldeia com adjetivos úteis.

Modern, old e historic descrevem edifícios. Beautiful e ugly dão a tua opinião.
Reforça-os com very, quite ou really: It's really busy at night.
pt.q: Como descreverias o sítio onde vives em três adjetivos?

pt_BR.g: Descreva sua cidade ou bairro com adjetivos úteis.

Modern, old e historic descrevem prédios. Beautiful e ugly dão sua opinião.
Reforce com very, quite ou really: It's really busy at night.

pt_BR.c: Escreva uma descrição curta da sua rua ou bairro com cinco adjetivos.

vocab.ex: The city centre is very busy on Saturdays.

target.gram: Adjectives go before the noun (a quiet street) or after be (The street is quiet). Make them stronger with very, really, quite.

en.g: Talk about animals and the pets you like or have.
p: Common pets: dog, cat, rabbit, bird, fish, hamster.
Farm and wild animals: horse, cow, sheep, lion, elephant, monkey.

Bauernhof- und Wildtiere: horse, cow, sheep, lion, elephant, monkey.
